name_zh: 斯里兰卡内战/泰米尔/少数族裔自治/和平进程
description_zh: 斯里兰卡内战 (1983-2009) 泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织与政府军之间的冲突，涉及种族、宗教、语言、领土争端，导致超过7万人死亡，最终政府军获胜，泰米尔问题成为斯里兰卡政治核心议题，影响南亚地区稳定。
description_en: Sri Lankan Civil War (1983-2009) conflict between Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam and government forces, involving racial, religious, linguistic, territorial disputes, resulting in over 70,000 deaths, government forces eventually won, Tamil issue became core Sri Lankan political issue, affecting South Asian regional stability.
reason_zh: 斯里兰卡内战代表少数族裔自治如何影响国家统一进程，展示了种族冲突如何塑造政治格局，其和平进程影响了区域冲突解决模式，其难民问题影响了国际人道主义政策，其遗产影响了斯里兰卡国家认同。
reason_en: Sri Lankan civil war represents how minority autonomy affects national unity process, demonstrates how racial conflict shapes political landscape, its peace process influences regional conflict resolution models, its refugee issue influences international humanitarian policies, its legacy influences Sri Lankan national identity.
steps_zh: 研究斯里兰卡殖民历史/种族构成/独立后政治
分析1983年内战爆发/泰米尔诉求/国际反应
探讨1990-2009年和谈进程/和平协议/军事行动
评估2009年内战结束/重建进程/政治和解
总结冲突遗产/种族关系/区域影响/国际调解
steps_en: Study Sri Lankan colonial history/racial composition/post-independence politics
Analyze 1983 civil war outbreak/Tamil demands/international response
Evaluate 2009 civil war end/reconstruction process/political reconciliation
Summarize conflict legacy/racial relations/regional impact/international mediation
expected_zh: 理解少数族裔自治如何影响国家统一进程，掌握种族冲突的政治根源，评估和平进程对区域冲突解决的影响，认识国际调解在冲突解决中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how minority autonomy affects national unity process, grasp political roots of racial conflict, evaluate peace process impact on regional conflict resolution, recognize international mediation role in conflict resolution.
case_zh: 1983年内战爆发；1995年和平协议；2009年内战结束。种族冲突/少数族裔权利/和平进程/国家重建。
case_en: 1983 Civil War outbreak; 1995 Peace Agreement; 2009 Civil War end. Racial conflict/Minority rights/Peace process/National reconstruction.
cross_cultural_impact: South Asian ethnic conflicts/Regional stability/International humanitarian law/Diaspora politics/Cultural identity
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 政治谈判/国际调解/军事手段
